name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central sector income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments directly into the bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
governing_department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year distributed in 3 equal four-monthly instalments of ₹2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

rules.description: Must be a cultivable landholding farmer family with land records in the state land database
Primary family livelihood must include farming/agriculture
Applicant or family members must NOT be an income tax payee in the last assessment year

required_documents: Active Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under the Farmers Corner section.
Enter Aadhaar number, state, and captcha code, then verify via Aadhaar OTP.
Fill in land identification details (District, Sub-District, Village, Survey/Khata/Khasra number).
Upload scanned land ownership document and submit for State Nodal Officer verification.
application_dates: Open year-round on the PM-KISAN portal
notes: Institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, and serving/retired government employees are excluded.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF) to provide social security in their old age.
governing_department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare in partnership with Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
benefit_summary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon attaining the age of 60 years.

rules.description: Entry age must be between 18 and 40 years
Must possess cultivable land up to 2.0 hectares (small and marginal farmer)
Applicant must be a practicing farmer

required_documents: Land Record Documents (Khasra / Khatauni showing up to 2 hectares)
Savings Bank Account Passbook with IFSC code
application_steps: Visit the nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) or self-register at https://maandhan.in.
Provide Aadhaar number and IFSC code for initial auto-debit consent.
Pay initial monthly contribution (₹55 to ₹200 based on entry age); matching contribution deposited by Central Govt.
Obtain Kisan Pension Card with unique Pension Scheme Number.
notes: Farmers covered under other statutory social security schemes like NPS, ESIC, EPFO are excluded.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: The world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, providing secondary and tertiary care hospitalization cover to low-income and vulnerable families.
governing_department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_summary: Cashless and paperless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

rules.description: Must be listed in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria or hold a valid BPL/Ration card
Annual household income generally below ₹2,50,000

required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Government Photo Identity Card
Ration Card or BPL Certificate showing family member listing
application_steps: Check eligibility on https://mera.pmjay.gov.in or visit the nearest empanelled public/private hospital.
Meet the Ayushman Mitra at the Help Desk with your Aadhaar and Ration Card.
Complete biometric e-KYC verification.
Generate and receive your PVC Ayushman Card with unique ABHA/PM-JAY ID.
application_dates: Open continuous registration and card issuance
notes: No cap on family size, age, or gender. Pre-existing conditions are covered from day one.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Centrally sponsored conditional cash transfer maternity benefit scheme to promote institutional delivery, child vaccination, and health-seeking behavior.
governing_department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefit_summary: Direct cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two instalments for the first child, and ₹6,000 in a single instalment for a second girl child.

rules.description: Applicant must be a pregnant woman or lactating mother
Must be expecting or lactating mother with registered pregnancy
Minimum age of mother should be 19 years at the time of pregnancy
Must belong to socially/economically disadvantaged category (SC/ST/BPL/annual income under ₹8,00,000)

required_documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card registered with Anganwadi/Health facility
Aadhaar Card of pregnant woman and husband
Aadhaar-linked Bank Passbook of the woman
Child Birth Certificate (for 2nd instalment/girl child benefit)
application_steps: Register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved Health Centre within 570 days of LMP.
Submit Form 1A along with MCP card copy and Aadhaar details.
Can also apply online at https://pmmvy.wcd.gov.in using citizen login.
Instalments are credited directly to the mother's bank account via DBT.
application_dates: Within 570 days from Last Menstrual Period (LMP)
notes: Women in regular employment with Central/State Govt or PSUs are not eligible.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
description: Provides financial assistance to rural houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses for building a disaster-resilient pucca house with basic amenities.
benefit_summary: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/northeast areas, plus 90-95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 for toilet construction.

rules.description: Must be residing in a rural village area
Family must belong to BPL or low-income household without any pucca house anywhere in India
Household must not already own a concrete pucca house

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant and family members
Land / House site ownership document or Gram Panchayat consent
application_steps: Identification is conducted through Gram Sabha based on SECC 2011 and Awaas+ list.
Gram Panchayat forwards verified beneficiary list to Block Development Officer (BDO).
Geo-tagged photos of existing kutcha site uploaded on AwaasApp.
Sanction order generated on https://pmayg.nic.in; instalments disbursed in 3 stages linked to construction milestones.
application_dates: Rolling identification via Gram Sabha and Awaas+ survey
notes: Houses constructed must be in the name of the female head or joint ownership.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
description: Comprehensive housing mission to address urban housing shortage among Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Low Income Groups (LIG).
governing_department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Up to ₹2,50,000 central assistance for Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) or interest subsidy up to 6.5% under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).

rules.description: Must reside in a designated statutory urban town or municipal area
Annual household income must not exceed ₹3,00,000 for EWS or ₹6,00,000 for LIG
Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India

required_documents: Aadhaar Number and Voter ID / Passport
Proof of Annual Income (Salary slip / ITR / Tehsildar income certificate)
Land title or allotment letter (for beneficiary-led construction)
Affidavit affirming no pucca house ownership in India
application_steps: Visit the official portal https://pmaymis.gov.in or Common Services Centre (CSC).
Select 'Citizen Assessment' and choose applicable component (e.g., Beneficiary-led Construction).
Verify Aadhaar card number.
Fill out personal, income, present address, and bank account details.
Submit and note down Application Assessment ID to track status with Urban Local Body (ULB).
application_dates: Ongoing via Urban Local Bodies and PMAY-MIS portal
notes: Adult female membership in house title is mandatory for EWS/LIG beneficiaries.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Provides scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage.
governing_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
benefit_summary: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from Class IX to Class XII in State Government, Government-aided, and Local body schools.

rules.description: Applicant must be a student currently studying in secondary school
Total parental income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000 per annum
Must have passed Class VII examination with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST)

required_documents: Class VII / VIII Marksheet with qualifying percentage
Parental Income Certificate issued by competent government authority
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
application_steps: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.gov.in).
Register with One Time Registration (OTR) using Aadhaar.
Select 'National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme' under Ministry of Education.
Upload marksheet, income certificate, and school verification document.
Submit application; verification conducted by School Institute Nodal Officer (INO) and District Nodal Officer (DNO).
application_dates: Academic session portal window (typically July to December annually)
notes: Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Navodaya Vidyalayas, and residential schools run by Govt are not eligible.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing comprehensive financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.
governing_department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_summary: Full compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement plus annual academic maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500 depending on course group.
benefit_amount: Full Tuition Fees + up to ₹13,500/year allowance

rules.description: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community
Must have passed Matriculation (Class 10) or Higher Secondary and enrolled in recognized post-matric course
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum

required_documents: Valid Caste Certificate issued by revenue authority (Tehsildar / SDO)
Income Certificate showing annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
College Admission Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.gov.in) or state scholarship portal.
Fill scholarship application form with student details, course name, and institute affiliation.
Upload caste certificate, income proof, and previous academic transcript.
Submit online for institutional verification and state department approval.
application_dates: Annual academic portal cycle (July to December)
notes: Scholarship is paid directly to students' accounts via DBT using 60:40 Centre-State sharing pattern.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed social security pension scheme aimed primarily at the unorganized sector workers to provide income security during old age.
governing_department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_summary: Guaranteed monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60, based on monthly contribution.

rules.description: Subscriber entry age must be between 18 and 40 years
Subscriber must NOT be an income tax payer (as per rule effective Oct 1, 2022)

required_documents: Savings Bank Account or Post Office Savings Account
application_steps: Approach the bank branch or post office where you hold a savings account, or log in to your bank's net banking.
Fill out the APY Registration Form selecting your chosen monthly pension slab (₹1,000 to ₹5,000).
Provide auto-debit consent for monthly/quarterly contribution deductions.
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) confirmation via SMS.
application_dates: Open enrollment year-round through all commercial and regional rural banks
notes: Same pension payable to spouse upon subscriber death; full accumulated corpus returned to nominee thereafter.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Non-contributory old-age social assistance pension scheme for senior citizens belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
governing_department: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP), Ministry of Rural Development
benefit_summary: Monthly pension of ₹200-₹500 central assistance (frequently supplemented to ₹1,000 - ₹2,500/month by respective state governments).

rules.description: Applicant must be 60 years of age or older
Applicant must belong to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL)

required_documents: Proof of Age (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Birth Certificate)
BPL Ration Card or SECC BPL inclusion certificate
Aadhaar-linked Bank Passbook or Post Office Savings Account
application_steps: Obtain application form from Block Development Office (Rural) or Municipality Office (Urban), or apply on https://nsap.nic.in.
Submit completed form with age proof, BPL card, and bank details to Social Welfare Department officer.
Field verification conducted by Village Panchayat Secretary or Ward Councillor.
Sanctioned pension disbursed directly to bank account on a monthly basis.
application_dates: Open continuous application through Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body
notes: Central share increases from ₹200 to ₹500/month upon reaching 80 years of age.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Special micro-credit facility scheme providing collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors affected by economic disruption.
governing_department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.

rules.description: Applicant must be engaged in street vending / hawking in urban or surrounding areas
Vending activity must be in urban or peri-urban jurisdiction

required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) OR Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
Active Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Visit the official PM SVANidhi portal at https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or approach a CSC.
Click 'Apply for Loan' and verify your mobile number with OTP.
Enter your Vending Card number or apply for Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee.
Select preferred Lending Institution (bank/NBFC/MFI) and submit application.
Loan sanctioned and disbursed directly to savings account with zero processing fee.
application_dates: Ongoing loan applications via official portal
notes: No collateral required. Timely repayment unlocks next higher loan tranches with cashbacks up to ₹1,200/year for digital payments.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Holistic end-to-end support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and traditional tools across 18 specified trades.
governing_department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefit_summary: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, free basic/advanced skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3,00,000 at 5% concessional interest.

rules.description: Must be an artisan or craftsperson working in one of 18 eligible traditional family-based trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, sculptor, cobbler, tailor, etc.)
Minimum age of 18 years on the date of registration
Registration restricted to one member per family; person must not have taken similar Govt credit (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi) in past 5 years

required_documents: Active Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Visit the nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and mobile phone.
Complete biometric Aadhaar authentication on https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
Select trade and provide family and bank details.
Application is verified across 3 tiers: Gram Panchayat / ULB, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee.
Receive digital ID and certificate, enroll in 5-7 days training, and receive e-vouchers for toolkits.
application_dates: Open continuous registration across all CSC centers
notes: Covers 18 traditional trades including Carpenter, Boat Maker, Blacksmith, Potter, Sculptor, Cobbler, Mason, Basket/Mat Maker, Doll & Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net Maker.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
governing_department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME
benefit_summary: Government subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost for micro-enterprises up to ₹50 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹20 Lakh (service sector).

rules.description: Beneficiary must be at least 18 years of age
At least Class 8th pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing and ₹5 Lakh in service

required_documents: Special Category / Caste Certificate (if claiming 25%-35% higher subsidy for rural/SC/ST/OBC/Women)
EDP Training Certificate (can be completed online after in-principle sanction)
application_steps: Submit online application at https://kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal.
Select implementing agency (KVIC, KVIB, or DIC).
Upload applicant photograph, project profile, Aadhaar, and category certificates.
Application is forwarded electronically to selected financing bank for credit appraisal.
Upon bank sanction, margin money subsidy is deposited in a TDR account for 3 years before final credit.
application_dates: Portal open throughout the financial year
notes: Higher subsidy (35% in rural areas, 25% in urban) for special categories including Women, SC, ST, OBC, Ex-servicemen, Differently-abled.

name: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme in Top Companies
description: Flagship national internship scheme facilitating 12-month on-the-job training in India's top 500 corporate companies, offering exposure to real-life business environments and industry practices.
benefit_summary: 12-month internship with monthly financial assistance of ₹5,000 (₹4,500 from Central Govt via DBT + ₹500 CSR company contribution) plus a one-time grant of ₹6,000 for incidental expenses.

rules.description: Candidate age must be between 21 and 24 years
Must have passed at least Class 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Graduation (BA, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, BCA)
Candidate or family member must NOT be an income tax payer in the previous assessment year

application_steps: Visit the official PM Internship Scheme portal at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in.
Register as Candidate with Aadhaar-linked mobile verification.
Complete digital profile with educational qualifications and district location preferences.
Browse posted internship opportunities from participating companies and apply up to 5 vacancies.
Shortlisting conducted by companies; offer letter issued directly on portal with automated DBT stipend setup.
application_dates: Portal active with periodic application windows (Cycle-wise announcements)
notes: Hosted by top 500 companies under CSR provisions. Reservation as per affirmative action norms applies.

name: NITI Aayog Internship Scheme
description: Internship scheme allowing enrolled undergraduate and postgraduate students to interact closely with NITI Aayog verticals and gain firsthand experience in public policy, governance, and development initiatives.
benefit_summary: Unstipended honorary internship with high-level exposure to national policy design, empirical analysis, and an official Government of India Experience Certificate upon successful submission of report.

rules.description: Applicant must be pursuing undergraduate degree (completed 2nd year/4th sem) or post-graduate/research course
Must have secured at least 85% marks in Class 12th examination
Field of study must align with NITI Aayog policy verticals (Economics, Policy, Data, Agriculture, Engineering, Law, Social Sciences)

required_documents: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from college Principal / Dean / HOD
College Identity Card and latest semester grade sheet
Statement of Purpose (SOP) explaining policy interests
application_steps: Apply online exclusively on the NITI Aayog portal at https://www.niti.gov.in/internship.
Application portal opens on the 1st to 10th of every month.
Select preferred vertical (e.g. Agriculture, Economics, Health, Education, Skill Development).
Upload required NOC and academic transcripts.
Shortlisted applicants contacted by respective Verticals for verification and induction.
application_dates: 1st to 10th of every month online window
notes: Strict minimum 85% requirement in Class 12 for undergraduate students. Interns must arrange own stay in Delhi.

name: Digital India Internship Scheme
description: Hands-on technology internship for engineering and IT students to work on critical national public digital infrastructure, e-governance systems, AI initiatives, and cyber security.
governing_department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) & National Informatics Centre (NIC)
benefit_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹10,000 for 2 months (extendable to 3 months) and official Certificate of Internship issued by MeitY, Government of India.

rules.description: Must be pursuing recognized degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or MCA
Must have secured at least 60% aggregate marks in previous qualifying semester examinations
Must be currently enrolled in B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc (IT) program

required_documents: Recommendation Letter / Bonafide from Institute Dean or HOD
application_steps: Visit the official MeitY internship portal at https://www.meity.gov.in/internship-scheme.
Register during the announced summer/winter internship batch window.
Upload institutional sponsorship letter and marksheets.
Select technical area of interest (e.g. AI, Cyber Security, Digital Health, Cloud Architecture).
Selection committee reviews applications and publishes list of selected interns on portal.
application_dates: Seasonal portal cycles (Summer: March-April; Winter: October-November)
notes: Exclusively for students pursuing recognized computer science, IT, or electronics degrees.

name: The Urban Learning Internship Program (TULIP)
description: National program offering fresh graduates hands-on experiential learning opportunities in Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and Smart Cities across India to solve live urban development challenges.
governing_department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) & Ministry of Education / AICTE
benefit_summary: Experiential urban governance internship across municipal corporations and smart city SPVs, with stipend determined by host municipal body and joint MoHUA-AICTE Certificate.
benefit_amount: Stipend as per Urban Local Body (typically ₹6,000 - ₹12,000 / month)
geographic_coverage: All India (4,400+ Urban Local Bodies and 100 Smart Cities)

rules.description: Must be an Indian citizen with a completed undergraduate degree (B.Tech, B.Arch, B.Plan, B.Com, B.A., B.Sc)
Must be a fresh graduate applying within 18 to 24 months of graduation

required_documents: AICTE National Internship Portal Registration ID
application_steps: Register on the AICTE National Internship Portal (https://internship.aicte-india.org).
Search and filter by TULIP and your preferred city or state municipal corporation.
Select specific role (e.g., Solid Waste Management, GIS Mapping, Urban Transport, Smart City IT).
Submit application with digital resume and degree credential.
Urban Local Body evaluates profiles and conducts interviews/onboarding directly.
application_dates: Open continuous postings year-round on the AICTE portal
notes: Applicants must apply within 18 to 24 months of graduation. 4,400+ ULBs participate across all Indian states.

name: RBI Summer Placement Scheme
description: Prestigious central banking internship offering high-level empirical research experience in monetary economics, financial stability, digital payments, and banking supervision.
benefit_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹20,000 for up to 3 months conducting research under RBI economic departments with premier banking research credentials.
geographic_coverage: All India (RBI Central Office Mumbai & Regional Offices)

rules.description: Must be pursuing postgraduate studies (Economics, Finance, Management, Law, Data Science) or 5-year integrated course
Field of study must be Economics, Finance, Management, Law, or Data Science
Must be currently enrolled and pursuing academic study

required_documents: Brief CV and Statement of Research Interest
application_steps: Apply online via RBI Opportunities portal (https://opportunities.rbi.org.in).
Portal open from 15th September to 15th December annually for following summer.
Fill online application form and select preferred RBI regional office.
Shortlisted candidates undergo interview in January/February; selected list announced in March.
notes: Open to students pursuing postgraduate courses or 5-year integrated degrees in economics, finance, or law.
